sentences.l2: 夜が明け、太陽が農場を照らし始める朝、農家の男は鶏舎へと足を運ぶ。
sentences.l1: In the morning, when night has broken and the sun begins to light the farm, the farmer heads to the chicken coop.

sentences.l2: 彼が大切にしているのは、動物である鶏たちへの給餌だ。
sentences.l1: What he values is feeding the chickens, which are animals.

sentences.l2: この時間帯に与える食べ物は、地元で採れた新鮮な穀物と野菜を混ぜ合わせたものだ。
sentences.l1: The food given at this time of day is a mixture of fresh grain and vegetables harvested locally.

sentences.l2: 日の出と共に目覚める鶏の健康こそが、栄養豊富な卵を産んでもらうための条件だからである。
sentences.l1: This is because the health of chickens that wake with the sunrise is precisely the condition for having them lay nutritious eggs.

sentences.l2: 彼にとって、毎朝のこの作業は生活のリズムを作る重要な儀式となっている。
sentences.l1: For him, this work every morning has become an important ritual that creates the rhythm of his life.
